description: Accept liability for a dispute claim via POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/accept-claim. The disputed amount is refunded to the buyer. Terminal action.

accept_claim_reason.description: Optional reason code (DID_NOT_SHIP_ITEM, TOO_TIME_CONSUMING, LOST_IN_MAIL, etc).

body.description: Additional accept-claim body fields merged into the request.

note.description: Required note explaining the merchant's reason for accepting.

name: accept_dispute_claim
